BestUNESCO World Heritage Sites

UNESCO-listed cultural and natural sites chosen for being worth the journey. There are well over a thousand inscriptions and they are emphatically not equally interesting — the designation records significance to humanity, not visitor experience, and a fair number are working landscapes or archaeological sites with very little to look at.

Iguazu National Park
Argentina / Brazil
Straddles Argentina & Brazil
A sweeping system of hundreds of waterfalls spanning the Argentine-Brazilian border, set within subtropical rainforest rich in wildlife and inscribed for its natural grandeur.
